shell_commands: cd src/orchestration/tools && npm test -- registry.test.ts 2>&1 | head -150
cd src/orchestration/tools && timeout 300 npm test -- registry.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -50
cd src/orchestration/tools && timeout 300 npm test -- registry.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -60
npm run prettier -- --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts 2>&1 | head -30

git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(tools): add comprehensive unit tests for input schema validation

Add unit tests for pass-through behavior with extra properties, static schema
compilation caching, and unknown tool error handling. Add doc comment to
execute() pointing to the specification. Update spec status to Implemented
and add validation links for all new tests.
EOF
)" && echo "Commit successful"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit && echo "Merge completed"
